summary: Frontend-only regression test for Atypic Calendar refactor (templates removed, slider-based impacts, i18n with auto-detection, Settings finalized). All 14 requested frontend behaviors verified PASS via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844) against Expo web preview. Backend skipped per request (already verified in iteration 1).

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web warnings in console (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), and an Invalid DOM property warning for transform-origin -> transformOrigin. These don't break functionality but should be cleaned up at some point.

action_items: Optional cleanup: address React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow* -> boxShadow, pointerEvents, transform-origin) to silence console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/i18n.ts: language is captured at module init (const lang = detectLang()). Acceptable for current MVP scope; future per-user language switch would require refactor to a runtime locale provider/context.
Imports of Plus/Minus icons in event/new.tsx are still used for the duration stepper, so unused-import lint is fine. Slider thumb/track styling renders correctly on web.
seed_data_creation: Created one event 'TEST_Doctor' (resource type, +15 cognitive) on today's date via the UI to verify save flow. Cleanup not done; main agent can ignore or clear from UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend flows working end-to-end on mobile viewport. Verified: onboarding (EN 'Get started'), calendar with 3 donuts + Day/Week/Month, FAB opens modal, no Templates section, title placeholder 'Doctor', type-task/type-resource pills, 3 ImpactSlider rows with sliders + 0/25/50/75 scale, sign auto-applied (Task=-15 violet, Resource=+15 green), event save closes modal and event appears in day list, Stats tab loads with no MVP wording, Settings shows setting-language row with current language ('English') and no MVP anywhere. Default browser locale was English so EN dictionary used as expected.
